optional stronger shared isolation or remote execution

offline path is real where declared

codexWorkPackage.goal: Implement the smallest real self-hosted browser/WASM Python execution provider behind the existing BAUMAN_PYTHON_PRODUCT facade so run/public-test practice can work locally/offline without paid cloud credentials, while preserving the existing Cloudflare Container provider as an optional high-fidelity provider.
codexWorkPackage.rootCause: The learner product is currently network-only: python-product-integration.js routes all run/test/submit/runtime actions to /api/python/* and python-lab.js disables execution whenever navigator.onLine is false. This conflicts with Constitution 1.2 and the accepted local-first provider decision.
codexWorkPackage.canonicalOwner: PYTHON04 runtime/provider layer projected through subjects/programming Python product integration; PYTHON05 may receive only the minimum UI/product changes needed to expose truthful provider/offline behavior.
allowedFiles: subjects/programming/assets/** new Python browser provider/worker/runtime files
scripts/** only if required for deterministic vendoring/build of self-hosted WASM runtime assets
forbiddenScope: PYTHON01-PYTHON03 curriculum, canonical entities, assessment truth, mastery rules or learner-state ownership
Deleting or weakening cloudflare/python-sandbox-provider.mjs or cloudflare/runtime-worker-python.mjs
Changing hidden tests so they execute in the browser
Making Google Drive/Sheets/Apps Script part of Python execution
Production deployment, release merge, or STABLE claims
Adding a mandatory paid/CDN runtime dependency
implementationRules: Use a provider-neutral router behind BAUMAN_PYTHON_PRODUCT.invoke.
Browser provider must execute in a Web Worker or equivalent isolated worker boundary.
Run and public tests may use browser/WASM when the task/profile is supported; submit with hidden tests remains trusted-provider-only.
Offline Run/Test must remain usable after required self-hosted runtime assets are cached/available; do not claim offline if runtime still requires a public CDN.
Cancellation must terminate/recycle the worker or otherwise prove execution cannot continue after cancel.
Enforce bounded execution time and bounded stdout/stderr; unsupported semantics/packages must fail explicitly.
Expose exact browser runtime identity/profile and capability limitations.
Do not expose hidden expected values or hidden test material to the browser.
Preserve existing Cloudflare Container behavior and tests as optional-provider evidence.
requiredTests: Worker execution golden fixtures: canonical solution, equivalent alternate solution, wrong solution
Existing python-p4 provider tests remain green
acceptanceCriteria: No paid/cloud credential is needed for supported Run/Public Test practice.
Offline Run/Public Test works from self-hosted/cached assets for the declared browser profile.
Submit/hidden evaluation remains outside browser and clearly reports trusted-provider requirement.
Runtime identity is exact and provider-specific but not learner-state identity.
Existing Cloudflare managed provider remains intact and optional.
Targeted P4/P5/P6 regressions pass on the exact implementation head.
codexWorkPackage.stopCondition: Stop and return BLOCKED_BY_SCOPE if a safe browser/WASM provider cannot be implemented without altering PYTHON01-PYTHON03 truth, exposing hidden tests, requiring a mandatory CDN/paid service, or changing unrelated architecture. Do not broaden scope.
